entry_timing.explanation:
Entry timing is a weighted average of independent factors, each scored from -100 (poor moment) to +100 (good moment):

  RSI 1h = 80.9 -> -70 (weight 2.0) - Extremely overbought - a poor moment to add
  Bollinger position = 94% of band -> -70 (weight 1.2) - 0% = lower band, 100% = upper band
  distance to EMA20 = +5.69% -> -34 (weight 1.8) - Price 106.00 vs EMA20 100.29
  MACD divergence (1d) = bearish -> -35 (weight 1.3) - strength 100/100
  resistance proximity = 36.6% away -> +25 (weight 1.0) - Room before the next resistance
  MACD divergence (1h) = bearish -> -9 (weight 1.3) - strength 25/100
  RSI daily = 60.3 -> -6 (weight 1.2) - Neutral momentum zone

  weighted sum / total weight (9.8) = -33.2 -> UNFAVORABLE
  Note: an imminent scheduled macro release is applied as a CAP on the score (weight 0 above), never averaged in - it can only worsen the moment.

Thresholds: >= +45 VERY_FAVORABLE, >= +15 FAVORABLE, -15..+15 WAIT, <= -15 UNFAVORABLE, <= -45 VERY_UNFAVORABLE.
